mapper.select: select id, uuid, user_id, workflow_id, status, status_remark, input_tokens, output_tokens, duration, create_time, checkpoint from adi_workflow_runtime where uuid = #{uuid} and is_deleted = false limit 1
mapper.update: update adi_workflow_runtime set status = 2 where uuid = #{uuid} and status = 5 and is_deleted = false

update adi_workflow_runtime set "output" = #{output,typeHandler=com.moyz.adi.common.base.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, status = #{status}, input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, duration = #{duration}, checkpoint = #{checkpoint} where id = #{id} and is_deleted = false

update adi_workflow_runtime set status = #{status}, status_remark = #{statusRemark}, input_tokens = #{inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{outputTokens}, duration = #{duration}, checkpoint = null where id = #{id} and is_deleted = false
update adi_workflow_runtime set status = 4, status_remark = #{remark}, checkpoint = null where status = 5 and is_deleted = false and update_time < #{threshold}
